clusters.canonical_name: Resident lighting for safety and comfort
clusters.objective: Maintain adequate home lighting across morning, evening, and night-waking contexts so the resident can move, relax, and read safely and comfortably.
clusters.meaningful_failure: Resident experiences discomfort, unsafe low-light conditions, or disrupted relaxation/reading when lighting is absent or mis-timed.
clusters.authorized_action_scope: Implicitly authorized to set and trigger home lighting schedules (morning/evening rules, motion-triggered night lighting) on the resident's behalf.
clusters.rationale: Both coders rated the single unit strongly_implies with recurring temporal scope and identifiable self beneficiary; delegation accepted as automation; authorized_action_scope implicit; after adjudication the failure meaning is discomfort. Direct-path admission threshold is met.
clusters.boundary_notes: Not merged with thermal-comfort/heating rules (userneeds_u15_r088, userneeds_u15_r090) because the maintained outcome is lighting, not warmth. Not merged with hypothetical low-threshold rules in the same packet. Single-unit admission; no cross-study convergent demand for lighting exists yet.
coding_disagreements: failure_meaning: luna=discomfort vs kimi=unknown; adjudicated to discomfort (supported by the paper's comfort/relaxation framing).
